name: marauding_blight_priest_1
notes: P70ef72b612 G4 (verifier v1). Printed: 'Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.' Two of the opponent's Pelakka Wurms enter (the opponent gains 7 twice: no trigger), then seat 0's Pelakka Wurm enters (seat 0 gains 7 once: the opponent loses 1). Life: seat 0 20 + 7 = 27, seat 1 20 + 14 - 1 = 33. A trigger on the opponent's gains would cost seat 1 two more (31 or 32).
